bridgeRouteRisk.summary: frxUSD has native issuance on Ethereum and Fraxtal, Fraxtal canonical-side lockbox and L2 bridge machinery, and established LayerZero/FraxZero OFT representations on other chains. The reviewed cross-chain routes depend on external messaging, endpoint configuration, peer/DVN/rate-limit settings, and lock/mint or burn/mint contracts outside issuer-native redemption, so Pharos scores the overall route as external lock/mint. The Tempo deployment is now reviewed as a FraxOFTMintableAdapterTIP20 bridge representation; the conflicting Tempo architecture-page status is retained as an evidence note rather than silently resolved.
